title: Each connector's freshness
description: What GET /api/v1/connectors answers and `ingestion connectors list --json` prints: each connector in the set in force, by name, with its last delivery, its items by stage and when the scheduler next makes it due. GET /api/v1/connectors/{name} answers one connector with its first fill, which `ingestion connectors show --json` prints.

applied_commit.description: The commit of the set in force, and null where no set has been applied.

zone.description: The connector's default zone for what it carries.

source.description: The external feed the connector reads, by its name in the data catalog.

tags.description: The tags every item the connector lands carries.

applied_commit.description: The commit of the set in force.

last_run_ts.description: When the scheduler last ran a poll or scanned a folder.

last_error.description: Why the scheduler's last run of a poll or a folder failed, and null once a run succeeds. It can quote outsider text, such as a file's name.

failures.description: The runs that failed in a row since the last that succeeded. Each moves the retry further off, up to the connector's next scheduled time.

waiting.description: Items whose phase is waiting, as items-list.schema.json#/$defs/phase defines it. Each item counts under its phase alone.

review.description: Items whose phase is review, the items that `ingestion review list` lists.

failed.description: Items whose phase is failed, as items-list.schema.json#/$defs/phase defines it.

schedule.description: A poll's or a folder's schedule.

due_interval.description: How often a drop or push is expected.

freshness.description: How long a poll or a folder may go without a delivery before it reads overdue.

due_at.description: When the scheduler next makes the connector due. A finished connector keeps its finished time here, and the scheduler never makes it due again.

overdue.description: True once due_at has passed with no delivery since, or for a poll or a folder declaring a freshness, once its last delivery is older than that. Always false for a connector whose finished_ts is set.

overdue_since.description: When the connector went overdue, the earlier of the two instants that overdue rests on, and null while it is not overdue. Absent from a server older than this field.

finished_ts.description: When a connector scheduled once ran a poll that landed everything it found, after which the scheduler never runs it. Null until then and for every other connector, and absent from a server older than this field.

item_key.description: The one item the held fill ran end to end.

held.description: Items whose model stage the fill holds behind it.

tokens.description: That item's tokens, by model stage.
